concepts.title: 次数与端行为
concepts.summary: 多项式的次数与首项系数决定两端方向；代入零求y截距。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 奇次两端相反，偶次两端相同；实零点最多为次数，偶重根可使不同截点个数为奇数。

en.title: Degree and end behaviour
en.summary: Degree and leading coefficient determine both tails; substitute zero for the y-intercept.

method.title: Method
method.body: Odd degrees have opposite tails and even degrees have matching tails. The number of distinct real zeros is at most the degree; even multiplicities can make the number of distinct intercepts odd.

method.title: 方法
method.body: 按降幂排列并补零；逐次除、乘、减；或逐列合成除法。

method.title: Method
method.body: Order by descending powers, insert zeros, then divide, multiply and subtract, or perform synthetic division.

method.title: 方法
method.body: 试常数项的因数，降次并继续分解；应用题检查每个尺寸为正。

method.title: Method
method.body: Test divisors of the constant term, reduce the degree and factor further. In applications require every dimension to be positive.

concepts.title: 零点、重数与图像
concepts.summary: 奇重根穿过x轴，偶重根接触后返回；符号由每个因子的正负决定。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 列截点、y截距和端行为，在每个相邻零点区间试值，再画光滑曲线。

en.title: Zeros, multiplicity and graphs
en.summary: An odd-multiplicity zero crosses the x-axis; an even-multiplicity zero touches and returns. Factor signs determine the sign of the function.

method.title: Method
method.body: List zeros, the y-intercept and end behaviour, test each interval between zeros, and sketch a smooth curve.

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先水平比例及反射，再竖直比例及反射，最后平移。

method.title: Method
method.body: Apply horizontal scaling/reflection, vertical scaling/reflection, then translations.

exercises.prompt: 哪些是多项式函数？说明理由。(a) $y=\sqrt{x+1}$；(b) $f(x)=3x^4$；(c) $g(x)=-3x^3-2x^2+x$；(d) $y=\frac12x+7$。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: (a) 根式含变量，不能写成只有非负整数幂的有限和，所以不是。(b) 幂为4，系数为3，所以是四次多项式。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: (c) 幂3、2、1均为非负整数，所以是三次。(d) 分数是常数系数，幂为1和0，所以是一次。

en.prompt: Which of the following are polynomial functions? Justify your answer. (a) $y=\sqrt{x+1}$; (b) $f(x)=3x^4$; (c) $g(x)=-3x^3-2x^2+x$; (d) $y=\frac12x+7$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (a) The variable is under a square root; it is not a finite sum of nonnegative integer powers, so it is not polynomial. (b) Power 4 and coefficient 3 give a degree-4 polynomial.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (c) Powers 3, 2, 1 are nonnegative integers: degree 3. (d) A fractional constant coefficient is allowed; the powers are 1 and 0: degree 1.

exercises.prompt: 用次数与首项系数的符号描述端行为，说明可能的x截点个数与y截距。(a) $s(x)=x^4-3x^2+5x$；(b) $p(x)=-x^3+5x^2-x+4$；(c) $y=3x-2$；(d) $y=2x^2-4$；(e) $y=2x^5-3x^3+1$。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: (a) 次数4、首项正：两端向上，$s(0)=0$。(b) 次数3、首项负：左上右下，$p(0)=4$。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: (c) 次数1、正：左下右上，y截距−2，恰有1个x截点。(d) 次数2、正：两端向上，y截距−4；由次数可有0、1或2个不同x截点，本函数解 $2x^2-4=0$ 得两个。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: (e) 次数5、正：左下右上，y截距1。仅由次数判断，四次可有0–4个、三次可有1–3个、五次可有1–5个不同实截点；偶重根不能当作两个不同截点。具体(a)有2个，(b)有1个，(e)有3个。

exercises.answer: (a) 上/上，0；(b) 上/下，4；(c) 下/上，−2；(d) 上/上，−4；(e) 下/上，1。可能个数与实际个数见步骤。

en.prompt: Use the degree and sign of the leading coefficient to describe the end behaviour. State the possible number of x-intercepts and the y-intercept. (a) $s(x)=x^4-3x^2+5x$; (b) $p(x)=-x^3+5x^2-x+4$; (c) $y=3x-2$; (d) $y=2x^2-4$; (e) $y=2x^5-3x^3+1$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (a) Degree 4, positive leading coefficient: both tails up; $s(0)=0$. (b) Degree 3, negative leading coefficient: left up, right down; $p(0)=4$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (c) Degree 1, positive: left down, right up; y-intercept −2 and exactly one x-intercept. (d) Degree 2, positive: both tails up, y-intercept −4. Degree alone allows 0, 1 or 2 distinct x-intercepts; this function has two from $2x^2-4=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (e) Degree 5, positive: left down, right up, y-intercept 1. From degree alone, quartics allow 0–4, cubics 1–3, and quintics 1–5 distinct real intercepts; an even-multiplicity root is one distinct intercept. Specifically (a) has 2, (b) has 1, and (e) has 3.

en.answer: (a) up/up, 0; (b) up/down, 4; (c) down/up, −2; (d) up/up, −4; (e) down/up, 1. Possible and actual intercept counts are explained above.

exercises.prompt: 跳伞者从11500 ft高处跳下，跳下后t秒的高度（ft）为 $h(t)=11500-16t^2$。(a) 这是什么类型的函数？(b) 12秒后的高度？(c) 何时高1500 ft？(d) 大约多久到地面？

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: (c) $1500=11500-16t^2\Rightarrow t^2=625\Rightarrow t=25$ s，舍去负时间。(d) $0=11500-16t^2\Rightarrow t=\sqrt{718.75}\approx26.81$ s。物理时间域 $0\le t\le26.81$（约）。

en.prompt: A parachutist jumps from a plane 11 500 ft above the ground. Height h, in feet, t seconds after the jump is modelled by $h(t)=11500-16t^2$. (a) What type of function is h(t)? (b) What is the height after 12 s? (c) When will the height be 1500 ft? (d) Approximately how long will it take to reach the ground?

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (a) The largest power is 2: a quadratic polynomial. (b) $h(12)=11500-16(144)=9196$ ft.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (c) $1500=11500-16t^2\Rightarrow t^2=625\Rightarrow t=25$ s, rejecting negative time. (d) $0=11500-16t^2\Rightarrow t=\sqrt{718.75}\approx26.81$ s. The physical time domain is approximately $0\le t\le26.81$.

exercises.prompt: 用余式定理求余数，再按指定方法作除法，写成 $\frac{P(x)}{x-a}=Q(x)+\frac R{x-a}$ 并列限制。(a) $x^3+9x^2-5x+3$ 除以 $x-2$，长除法；(b) $2x^3+x^2-2x+1$ 除以 $x+1$，长除法；(c) $12x^3+13x^2-23x+7$ 除以 $x-1$，合成除法；(d) $-8x^4-4x+10x^3+15$ 除以 $x+1$，合成除法。
exercises.answer: 四个余数依次为37、2、9、1；商和限制见各小问。

en.prompt: Use the remainder theorem to find the remainder, then divide using the indicated method. Express each result as $\frac{P(x)}{x-a}=Q(x)+\frac R{x-a}$ and state restrictions. (a) $x^3+9x^2-5x+3$ by $x-2$, long division; (b) $2x^3+x^2-2x+1$ by $x+1$, long division; (c) $12x^3+13x^2-23x+7$ by $x-1$, synthetic division; (d) $-8x^4-4x+10x^3+15$ by $x+1$, synthetic division.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (a) $P(2)=8+36-10+3=37$. Long division: subtract $x^2(x-2)$ to get $11x^2-5x+3$; subtract $11x(x-2)$ to get $17x+3$; subtract $17(x-2)$ to leave 37. Thus $\frac{P(x)}{x-2}=x^2+11x+17+\frac{37}{x-2}$, $x\ne2$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (b) $P(-1)=-2+1+2+1=2$. Subtract $2x^2(x+1)$ to leave $-x^2-2x+1$; subtract $-x(x+1)$ to leave $-x+1$; subtract $-1(x+1)$ to leave 2. Hence $\frac{P(x)}{x+1}=2x^2-x-1+\frac2{x+1}$, $x\ne-1$.

en.answer: Remainders: 37, 2, 9, 1 respectively; quotients and restrictions are shown for each part.

exercises.prompt: (a) $f(x)=x^4+kx^3-3x-5$ 除以 $x-3$ 余−14，求k。(b) 用该k求除以 $x+3$ 的余数。

en.prompt: (a) Determine k so that $f(x)=x^4+kx^3-3x-5$ leaves remainder −14 when divided by $x-3$. (b) Using that k, find the remainder when f(x) is divided by $x+3$.

exercises.prompt: $P(x)=4x^3-3x^2+bx+6$ 除以 $x-1$ 与 $x+3$ 的余数相同，求b。

en.prompt: For what b will $P(x)=4x^3-3x^2+bx+6$ have the same remainder when divided by both $x-1$ and $x+3$?

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: Set $7+b=-129-3b$, giving $4b=-136$, so $b=-34$. Both remainders are −27.

en.prompt: Which binomials are factors of $P(x)=x^3-x^2-16x+16$? Justify. (a) $x-1$; (b) $x+1$; (c) $x+4$; (d) $x-4$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: Test the corresponding zeros: (a) $P(1)=1-1-16+16=0$; (b) $P(-1)=-1-1+16+16=30$. Thus (a) is a factor and (b) is not.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (a) Substitution at −1 gives 0. Divide by $x+1$ to get $x^2-5x+6=(x-2)(x-3)$. Result: $(x+1)(x-2)(x-3)$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (c) Substitution at 1 gives 0; the quotient is $x^3-3x^2-4x+12$. Group it as $x^2(x-3)-4(x-3)=(x-3)(x-2)(x+2)$. Result: $(x-1)(x-3)(x-2)(x+2)$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (d) Divide twice by $x-1$ to obtain $x^3-x^2-8x+12$. Divide by $x-2$ to get $x^2+x-6=(x-2)(x+3)$. Hence $(x-1)^2(x-2)^2(x+3)$. Expanding $(x^4-6x^3+13x^2-12x+4)(x+3)$ returns the original polynomial.

exercises.prompt: 酒店入口使用的长方体花岗石块的体积（m³）为 $V(x)=2x^3+7x^2+2x-3$，x的单位为m。(a) 用x表示可能的尺寸。(b) x=1时的尺寸？

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: 这组三尺寸为正需 $x>\frac12$。(b) x=1时得2 m、1 m、4 m，体积8 m³；$V(1)=2+7+2-3=8$。

en.prompt: Rectangular blocks of granite for a hotel entrance have volume, in cubic metres, $V(x)=2x^3+7x^2+2x-3$, where x is in metres. (a) What are possible dimensions in terms of x? (b) What are the dimensions when x=1?

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: $V(-1)=-2+7-2-3=0$. Dividing by $x+1$ gives $2x^2+5x-3=(2x-1)(x+3)$. Possible dimensions are $x+1$, $2x-1$, $x+3$ metres.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: These three dimensions are positive when $x>\frac12$. (b) At x=1 they are 2 m, 1 m, 4 m, giving 8 m³; $V(1)=2+7+2-3=8$.

exercises.prompt: 求k，使 $x+3$ 是 $x^3+4x^2-2kx+3$ 的因式。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: $12+6k=0\Rightarrow k=-2$。此时 $P=(x+3)(x^2+x+1)$，乘回核对。

en.prompt: Determine k so that $x+3$ is a factor of $x^3+4x^2-2kx+3$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: The factor theorem requires $P(-3)=0$. Substitute to obtain $-27+36+6k+3=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: $12+6k=0\Rightarrow k=-2$. Then $P=(x+3)(x^2+x+1)$, verified by expansion.

exercises.prompt: 对每个函数，求图像的x截点、次数与端行为、零点及重数、y截距、正负区间，并画图。(a) $y=(x+1)(x-2)(x+3)$；(b) $y=(x-3)(x+2)^2$；(c) $g(x)=x^4-16x^2$；(d) $g(x)=-x^5+16x$。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: (b) 零点−2重数2、3重数1；截点 $(-2,0),(3,0)$。三次首项正，左下右上；y截距−12。$x<3$ 时除零点−2外平方因子为正而x−3为负；负区间 $(-\infty,-2)\cup(-2,3)$，正区间 $(3,\infty)$；−2处接触，3处穿过。

exercises.answer: 全部截点、重数、端行为和正负区间见(a)–(d)；四幅图如下。

en.prompt: For each function, determine the x-intercepts, degree and end behaviour, zeros and multiplicities, y-intercept, and intervals where the function is positive or negative. Then sketch the graph. (a) $y=(x+1)(x-2)(x+3)$; (b) $y=(x-3)(x+2)^2$; (c) $g(x)=x^4-16x^2$; (d) $g(x)=-x^5+16x$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (a) Zeros −3,−1,2 each have multiplicity 1, giving intercepts $(-3,0),(-1,0),(2,0)$. Degree 3 with positive leading term: left down/right up; y-intercept −6. Test −4,−2,0,3 to get signs −,+,−,+. Positive on $(-3,-1)\cup(2,\infty)$; negative on $(-\infty,-3)\cup(-1,2)$; cross at all three zeros.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (b) Zeros −2 (multiplicity 2) and 3 (multiplicity 1) give $(-2,0),(3,0)$. Degree 3, positive leading term: left down/right up; y-intercept −12. For x<3 the square is positive except at −2, while x−3 is negative. Negative on $(-\infty,-2)\cup(-2,3)$; positive on $(3,\infty)$. Touch at −2, cross at 3.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (c) $g=x^2(x-4)(x+4)$. Zeros −4,4 have multiplicity 1; 0 has multiplicity 2. Intercepts are $(-4,0),(0,0),(4,0)$; y-intercept 0. Degree 4, positive: both tails up. Positive on $(-\infty,-4)\cup(4,\infty)$; negative on $(-4,0)\cup(0,4)$. Cross at ±4 and touch at 0.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (d) $g=-x(x-2)(x+2)(x^2+4)$, whose last factor is always positive. Zeros −2,0,2 each have multiplicity 1, giving $(-2,0),(0,0),(2,0)$; y-intercept 0. Degree 5, negative: left up/right down. Tests at −3,−1,1,3 give +,−,+,−. Positive on $(-\infty,-2)\cup(0,2)$; negative on $(-2,0)\cup(2,\infty)$. Connect the intercepts consistently with these signs and tails as below.

en.answer: All intercepts, multiplicities, tails and sign intervals are given in (a)–(d); the four sketches are below.

exercises.prompt: $y=x^3$ 变为 $y=2(-4(x-1))^3+3$。(a) 参数与对应变换是什么？(b) 完成表格，依次为水平伸缩/关于y轴反射、竖直伸缩/关于x轴反射、左右平移、上下平移，写参数值及方程。(c) 画变换后的图像。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: (a) $a=2,b=-4,h=1,k=3$。水平压缩为原来的1/4并关于y轴反射，竖直拉伸2倍，右移1、上移3。

en.prompt: The graph of $y=x^3$ is transformed to $y=2(-4(x-1))^3+3$. (a) What are the parameters and corresponding transformations? (b) Complete the table: horizontal stretch/reflection in y-axis; vertical stretch/reflection in x-axis; translation left/right; translation up/down. Give the parameter value and equation in each row. (c) Sketch the transformed graph.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (a) $a=2,b=-4,h=1,k=3$. Horizontally compress by factor 1/4 and reflect in the y-axis; vertically stretch by 2; translate right 1 and up 3.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (b) Successive rows: b=−4 gives $y=(-4x)^3$; a=2 gives $y=2(-4x)^3$; h=1 gives $y=2(-4(x-1))^3$; k=3 gives $y=2(-4(x-1))^3+3$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (c) Map $(u,u^3)\mapsto(1-u/4,2u^3+3)$. Values u=−1,0,1 give $(1.25,1),(1,3),(0.75,5)$. The function is $-128(x-1)^3+3$, falling from left up to right down and flattening at (1,3).

en.answer: $a=2,b=-4,h=1,k=3$; successive equations and graph are shown in the solution.

exercises.prompt: 求与所给图(a)、(b)对应的多项式函数方程。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: (b) x=−1处穿过，x=2处平坦穿过，取重数1和3：$y=a(x+1)(x-2)^3$。y截距为8，$8=a(1)(-8)$，所以a=−1。这些是与给定曲线相符的标准最低次数方程；有限图形资料本身不唯一规定任意更高次数多项式。

en.prompt: Determine the equation of the polynomial function corresponding to each supplied graph (a), (b).

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (a) The least-degree model touches at x=−3 (multiplicity 2) and crosses at x=−1 (multiplicity 1), so $y=a(x+3)^2(x+1)$. Read $(-2,-1)$: $-1=a(1)(-1)$, hence a=1.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (b) The graph crosses at x=−1 and flattens while crossing at x=2: use multiplicities 1 and 3, giving $y=a(x+1)(x-2)^3$. The y-intercept is 8, so $8=a(1)(-8)$ and a=−1. These are the standard least-degree equations consistent with the supplied curves; finite graphical data alone do not uniquely fix arbitrary higher-degree polynomials.

exercises.prompt: 四次函数的零点为−2、−1、3（3的重数2）。(a) 求两个符合条件的函数方程。(b) 求同时经过(2,24)的函数方程。

en.prompt: The zeros of a quartic are −2, −1, and 3 (multiplicity 2). (a) Give equations for two functions satisfying this condition. (b) Find the equation also passing through (2,24).

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: The multiplicities sum to $1+1+2=4$, so the family is $y=a(x+2)(x+1)(x-3)^2$, $a\ne0$. (a) Choose a=1 and a=−1.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (b) Substitute (2,24): $24=a(4)(3)(1)=12a$, so a=2. Substitution checks 24 and all zero multiplicities remain unchanged.

exercises.prompt: 纸盒的宽比长少5 cm，高为长的两倍。(a) 写体积方程。(b) 体积384 cm³时各尺寸是多少？

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: 设长为x cm，宽x−5、高2x；$V(x)=x(x-5)(2x)=2x^3-10x^2$，实际域x>5。

en.prompt: A cardboard box has width 5 cm less than its length and height double its length. (a) Write an equation for the volume. (b) Find the dimensions if the volume is 384 cm³.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: Let the length be x cm; width is x−5 and height 2x. Thus $V(x)=x(x-5)(2x)=2x^3-10x^2$, with physical domain x>5.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: $2x^3-10x^2=384\Rightarrow x^3-5x^2-192=0=(x-8)(x^2+3x+24)$. The quadratic discriminant is $9-96=-87<0$, so x=8 is the only real root. Dimensions 8,3,16 cm multiply to 384.

en.answer: (a) $V=2x^2(x-5)$, x>5; (b) length 8 cm, width 3 cm, height 16 cm.
